verdict.rationale: Ultrametric documents a CLI path for installing its skill: `npm install -g ultrametric@0.4.1`, then `ultrametric init`, which writes the selected skill files (docs-6, docs-8). A hands-on dry run confirmed `init` would create SKILL.md under both `.agents/skills` (Codex) and `.claude/skills` (Claude Code), the locations those harnesses load from (selfeval-1, selfeval-2). The files can also be committed to share the setup with a team (docs-9). Missing for 10: a true single-command install (it takes an npm install followed by `init`), a hands-on run of the actual write rather than only the dry-run preview, an explicit documented statement that the skill is active in the next session, and an in-agent marketplace or plugin install option.
